name: Warnowtunnel toll (Rostock)
law: Warnow-QuerungMautHVO M-V (Anlage as newly set by the Verordnung of 22. September 2026, GVOBl. M-V S. 1123, valid from 01.11.2026): the toll per passage of the Warnow-Querung (B 105, Rostock), VAT included, for vehicles 2.60 m high or more by axles: category 3 (2 axles), 4 (3), 5 (4 or more); the winter price (1 November - 30 April), the summer price (1 May - 31 October) as the high season, and the '360 Tage' price as `etc`. Trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be 2.60 m high or more.

sources.title: Landesrecht Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: Warnow-QuerungMautHVO M-V, Gesamtausgabe (read in Chrome: tools/tables/browser/de-warnow-mauthvo.txt)

vehicles: Vehicles 2.60 m high or more (here: trucks over 3.5 t), by axles
tolled_roads: The Warnowtunnel (B 105 Rostock, km 1+040 to 3+160), charged at its toll plaza either way.
